description: This source file defines a static helper class for analyzing and managing serialization attributes within C# source code, particularly focusing on identifying members and types that need serialization attributes in the Orleans project.

classes.name: SerializationAttributesHelper
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to analyze C# type declarations for serialization attributes, generating analysis data including annotated and unannotated members, and next available ID for serialization purposes.

methods.name: ShouldGenerateSerializer
methods.description: Determines if a given type declaration should have a serializer generated based on its attributes and whether it is static.

methods.name: AnalyzeTypeDeclaration
methods.description: Analyzes a C# type declaration syntax node to identify members that are unannotated or annotated for serialization, and counts annotated constructors and assigns the next available ID.
